question: Which year did the Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment (TRYSEM) take place? (RPF Constable 2018 (10/02/2019))
options: 1969
1989
1999
1979
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1979

Explanation:
The TRYSEM (Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment) scheme was launched on 15 August 1979. Its objective was to provide skill training to rural youth (aged 18-35) to enable them for self-employment. Implemented under the Ministry of Rural Development, it was later merged with the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY). TRYSEM aimed to reduce unemployment in rural areas and promote self-reliance. After training, beneficiaries were provided bank loans and subsidies to create employment opportunities.

question: Which scheme is redesigned as Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana(SGSY)? (RPF Constable 2018 (10/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Prime Minister's Employment Plan (PMRY)
Prime Minister Twenty Point Program
Rural Employment Generation Program (REGP)
National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)

Explanation:
The Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) was redesigned and relaunched as the National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) in 2011. The objective of this scheme is to provide self-employment opportunities to rural poor families and improve their livelihoods. NRLM primarily focuses on empowering women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and promoting rural financial inclusion. The Prime Minister's Employment Plan (PMRY) and the Rural Employment Generation Program (REGP) are separate schemes, while the Prime Minister Twenty Point Program is a broad economic program. Hence, the correct answer is the National Rural Livelihood Mission.

☛ Launch year of NRLM → 2011
☛ Objective of NRLM → Improve livelihoods of rural poor
☛ Key vehicle of NRLM → Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
☛ Focus of NRLM → Women empowerment and financial inclusion
question_hi: किस योजना को स्वर्ण जयंती ग्राम स्वरोजगार योजना (SGSY) के रूप में पुनः डिजाइन किया गया है? (RPF Constable 2018 (10/02/2019) Shift 2)

Explanation:
स्वर्ण जयंती ग्राम स्वरोजगार योजना (SGSY) को वर्ष 2011 में पुनः डिजाइन कर राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन (NRLM) के रूप में लागू किया गया। यह योजना ग्रामीण गरीब परिवारों को स्वरोजगार के अवसर प्रदान करने और उनकी आजीविका में सुधार लाने के उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई थी। NRLM का मुख्य फोकस स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) के माध्यम से महिलाओं को सशक्त बनाना और ग्रामीण वित्तीय समावेशन को बढ़ावा देना है। प्रधानमंत्री रोजगार योजना (PMRY) और ग्रामीण रोजगार सृजन कार्यक्रम (REGP) अलग-अलग योजनाएँ हैं। प्रधानमंत्री बीस सूत्री कार्यक्रम एक व्यापक आर्थिक कार्यक्रम है। इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन है।

The scheme targeted youth aged 18-35 years, with preference given to women, SC/ST, and backward classes. PMRY played a key role in promoting entrepreneurship among educated youth in both urban and rural areas.

question: What is the goal of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 1)

Explanation:
The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) aims to provide at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households. question: Which of these programmes aims to improve the physical infrastructure in rural areas? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 1)

question: The National Rural Livelihood Mission was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, in the year ________.  (RPF Constable 2024 (06/03/2025) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following was launched to support farmers and enhance agricultural productivity in 2000?  (RPF Constable 2024 (06/03/2025) Shift 3)

question: The Government of India had launched Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY) in the year _____ for the rural areas with the objectives of electrification of all un-electrified villages, as per Census 2011. (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 1)

UDAN (Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik) योजना वर्ष 2016 में भारत सरकार द्वारा नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्रालय के तहत शुरू की गई थी। इसका उद्देश्य देश के दूरदराज और क्षेत्रीय हवाई अड्डों को जोड़ना और हवाई यात्रा को आम जनता के लिए सस्ती बनाना है। योजना के तहत, क्षेत्रीय कनेक्टिविटी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए एयरलाइनों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। UDAN योजना राष्ट्रीय नागरिक उड्डयन नीति (NCAP) 2016 का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है। इसने अब तक 70 से अधिक हवाई अड्डों को जोड़ा है, जिससे छोटे शहरों और कस्बों के लिए हवाई संपर्क सुलभ हुआ है।
